mode: read-only coverage inventory plus reference-library build stats

decisions.software_and_all_types: Both experiment arms should expose the same reference domains and source revisions; vary discovery and entrypoint shape only.
decisions.active_router: The A/B arms use the same full-domain reference library. The selected shipping layout and evidence are in audit/ab/DECISION.md; domain files remain indexes, not global skill entrypoints.
decisions.host_bound: Memory, hooks, installers, orchestration, notifications, and native UI assumptions are reference-only. M2D and host tools remain authoritative.

limits: Only selected sources were body-reviewed for prior adaptation. Remaining entries are retained and metadata-classified.
Domain labels use explicit source-name maps with engineering as the ECC default and uncategorized as the future-name fallback.
Version-sensitive and regulated material still requires current official-source verification at task time.
